run_qa_finetune: run a script to fine-tune a question answering model on HPU using Optimum Habana and the HuggingFace Trainer
run_qa_evaluate: run evaluation on a fine-tuned question answering model using the SQuAD dataset and compute exact match and F1 metrics
run_qa_predict: run predictions on a test dataset with a fine-tuned question answering model and save results to the output directory
create_ModelArguments: create a ModelArguments dataclass to configure the pretrained model name, tokenizer, config, cache directory, and revision for QA fine-tuning
create_DataTrainingArguments: create a DataTrainingArguments dataclass to configure dataset files, max sequence length, doc stride, and answer length for QA training
